terms.title: Terms of use
terms.s1p1: These terms govern the use of the WheelyLove website and booking classes through it. By registering an account and making a booking you agree to these terms.
terms.s1p2: [The exact legal name, EIK and registered address of the trader will be added here once provided.]
terms.s2p1: A booking is considered made once a phone number is provided. The booking is binding from the moment of confirmation — by email.
terms.s2li1: Payment is on site (in cash) at the studio, before the class starts. The booking stays pending until the studio confirms it upon receiving the payment.
terms.s3p1: You can cancel a booking at any time before the class starts via the “My bookings” section.
terms.s3li1: No amount is due when cancelling a pay-on-site booking.
terms.s3li2: Bookings for classes that have already started or finished cannot be cancelled.
terms.s3p2: The studio reserves the right to cancel a scheduled class (e.g. when an instructor is absent) — in that case all affected bookings are cancelled automatically and the customers are notified by email.
terms.s4p1: Classes involve physical exertion. By booking a class you declare that you are in good health and have no medical contraindications to taking part. We recommend consulting a doctor before starting a training programme, especially if you have existing health problems.
terms.s4p2: WheelyLove is not liable for injuries resulting from not following the instructor's instructions or from participating despite health contraindications.
terms.s5p1: Please arrive on time for your booked classes. With repeated no-shows without cancelling the booking, we reserve the right to limit the possibility of future bookings.
terms.s6p1: The content in the gallery (photos and videos) is property of WheelyLove and may not be used without permission.
terms.s7p1: We reserve the right to change these terms. Material changes will be announced to users via the website.
terms.s8p1: These terms are governed by Bulgarian law. See also our <privacyLink>Privacy policy</privacyLink>.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1p1: WheelyLove ("we", "us") is the controller of the personal data we process through this website. For questions about the processing of personal data you can reach us at <email>wheelylove@abv.bg</email> or by phone at +359 886 573 880.
privacy.s1p2: [The exact legal name, EIK and registered address of the trader will be added here once provided.]
privacy.s2li1: Name, email address and password (on sign-up/sign-in; the password is stored only hashed)
privacy.s2li2: Phone number (at the first booking, so the studio can reach you; it is saved in your profile so you don't type it every time, and you can change it from “My bookings”)
privacy.s2li3: Booking history — the chosen class, time and status
privacy.s2li4: Photos and videos in the gallery — uploaded by the studio and stored on our server
privacy.s3Title: 3. What we use the data for
privacy.s3li2: Sending confirmations and reminders by email
privacy.s3li3: Communication on cancellation or change of a booking
privacy.s3p1: The legal basis for the processing is the performance of a contract (the booking you make) and our legitimate interest in running the studio.
privacy.s4p1: We use the following service providers (processors of personal data):
privacy.s4li1: Resend — sending confirmation and reminder emails
privacy.s4li2: Cloudflare — protection and delivery of the website (CDN)
privacy.s4p2: Resend may process data on servers outside the European Union (USA). In those cases we rely on the standard contractual clauses and the guarantees provided by the respective provider to ensure an adequate level of protection. Profiles and bookings are stored on our own server.
privacy.s5p1: We keep booking data for as long as necessary to perform the contract and to meet legal obligations (e.g. accounting requirements), but no longer than 5 years from the account's last activity, unless the law requires otherwise.
privacy.s6p1: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) you have the right to:
privacy.s6li3: have the data erased (the “right to be forgotten”);
privacy.s6li7: lodge a complaint with the Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP) if you believe your rights have been violated.
privacy.s6p2: To exercise these rights, write to us at <email>wheelylove@abv.bg</email>.
privacy.s7p1: The website uses only technically necessary cookies — to keep you signed in and for the security of the site. We do not use cookies for advertising or third-party analytics.
privacy.s8p1: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, including an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and access to the admin panel only for authorised people.
